title: Letter to the Church, circa April 1834
source_note: “Elders” (including JS), Letter, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to “brethren in Christ, and companions in tribulation,” ca. Apr. 1834. Featured version published in The Evening and the Morning Star, Apr. 1834, p. 152. For more complete source information, see the source note for Letter, 30 Oct. 1833.
